sourceAuthoring: Three CC0-derived rigged adults, six existing native buildings and one native street.

captureMeasurement.scope: whole desktop scene including Google context; not laptop FPS

limitations: Facial identity and architecture can drift in the AI edit.
Take 6 reverses a secondary walker, changes clothing and adds distant pedestrians.
No pathfinding or crowd collision avoidance.
1080p Omni delivery dimensions do not establish native 1080p model synthesis.

visualReview.independentSampleReview: 48 output frames; take 6 also has eight matched source frames
